job_description:
Junior AI Engineer (m/f/d)

Profile:
Degree in computer science, machine learning, data engineering, or a related field.
Experience: First practical experience (e.g. internship, student project, open source) with data and AI, machine learning, or software development.
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
Interest in data, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Bonus: Familiarity with ML libraries (e.g. Hugging Face, LangChain) or DevOps tools (e.g. Docker).
Languages: Strong English skills; German is a plus.
Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

Why ARTEFACT?
Work on real data and AI projects with leading clients from day one.
Grow your career with mentoring, internal workshops, and certifications from partners like Google & Amazon.
Be part of an international team with strong team spirit, flat hierarchies, and a culture of learning.
Attractive benefits: hybrid work, flexible hours, 1 additional day off for your birthday, Christmas & New Year's Eve off, mental health support, 4 weeks of workation, corporate benefits, office brunch, team events, and more.
